jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, AI Accelerator
jobs.description: The Senior AI Engineer is the hands-on technical lead for assigned AI and GenAI initiatives. The listing asks for 7+ years of software experience and LLM/GenAI delivery, with RAG, agents, and cloud-native services.

jobs.title: Graduate Program: Technology, Digital and Data
jobs.description: Targets computer science, software engineering, cybersecurity and similar degrees, with rotations that include AI and analytics. Eligible candidates are final-year students who will have full working rights in Australia.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, ML Systems (AI Products)
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of production Python or equivalent. The role is software-engineering first, with on-call experience and familiarity with AWS and Kubernetes. Research background is not required. Listing dated August 2026.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, Data Analytics
jobs.description: Asks for 5+ years building production software, hands-on experience with agentic AI applications, and strong Python and SQL. Responsibilities include building agent capabilities such as retrieval-augmented generation and tool calling.

jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer, Business Accounts
jobs.description: The posting asks for 10+ years of backend development, Python or TypeScript/JavaScript skills, experience with vector databases, and a relevant degree. Responsibilities include leading AI solution creation and designing API and system architecture for AI applications. Preferred qualifications include experience in financial services, lending, payments, or credit products.

jobs.title: Staff AI & Data Engineer
jobs.description: Define and evolve platform architecture for data and AI workloads across Azure, Databricks, and related technologies. The role requires experience with large-scale data pipelines, medallion architecture, and real-time data integrations.

jobs.title: 27届秋招-算法工程师
jobs.description: 参与公司核心算法的设计与开发，成果应用于滴滴各产品线；搭建高效的算法平台，改善司机和乘客的使用体验。计算机、电子工程、自动化、数学等相关专业的2027届本科及以上毕业生；编程基础扎实，至少熟悉一门语言（如C++、Java、Scala、Python）。

jobs.title: 大模型算法实习生
jobs.description: 职位职责包括通过微调、结构设计和新的训练推理范式，将大模型能力落地到核心业务场景，并搭建包括Agents、RAG在内的LLM应用模块。任职要求中，要求为计算机或相关方向在读博士、硕士，并能保证6个月及以上的长期实习。

jobs.title: AI模型工程师（2027届校招）
jobs.description: 职责偏向记忆管理、规划推理和工具调用，深耕Agent上下文管理核心能力，并进行大模型预训练与微调、RLHF/DPO等对齐算法研发。任职要求2027届本科及以上学历，计算机、AI或数学相关专业，大模型与强化学习的理解必备，顶会论文或开源经验者优先。

jobs.title: 算法开发岗
jobs.description: 职责包括设计大模型在智能交互和AI-Agent场景下的算法方案，任职要求为硕士及以上学历、熟悉Python和PyTorch或TensorFlow，并有LLM训练、SFT、强化学习和RAG的实战经验。发布时间2026-08-18，北京。
